I bought a small 4 oz bottle of glycerin which is pretty cheap (about $5) to incorporate into my lotions and for making my own toner a few months ago and glycerin is the OG humectant tried and true. It’s super gloopy but a little goes a long way and this is the gloopy stickiness you feel in the serum. I’ve never encountered a serum filled with this much glycerin and the mixture of the hyaluronic acid makes it more sticky than usual. This could potentially be a great serum if the base of glycerin was lowered a bit and maybe add some aloe juice water instead to thin it out?  With that said I’m going to end up returning bc I already have a bottle of glycerin and it doesn’t make sense to keep a small bottle with less product for the same price. I will opt to buy another cheap hyaluronic acid serum but one that is extremely light/watery in texture, in case I want to cocktail these ingredients myself. I would purchase if I was a beginner but since I’ve become pickier with textures I’m going to pass.

reviews.review_title: very occlusive and thick but works for acne-prone
reviews.review_text: I’ve read other reviews on this cream complaining that it doesn’t soak in or is too thick but i have combo leaning oily and sensitive acne-prone skin and this feels extremely nourishing and soothing and surprisingly not greasy at all. I think the issue people might have with it is the lack of slip(humectants) and how it seems to not soak in so completely. I would say you’re probably not experienced with shea butter bc this feels almost exactly like cerave’s renewing night cream(which is half the price). I use less cream than i usually would with other creams because its so occlusive and the shea butter allows the cream to be thick without being greasy. I add a hyaluronic serum( the ordinary’s marine hyaluronic) and its fantastic. The serum gives the slip and that feeling of “sinking in“ that you might crave. Also apply this over a damp face and it locks in moisture extremely well while giving slip to slide the cream around your face before it settles. I use so little that the price seems justified bc of how long it will last but it’s definitely a winter/fall cream for me bc in summer this is too thick. I also have not broken out or gotten any irritation from use.

I dont switch cleansers often but before i used this one i was using cerave foaming cleanser and then drunk elephant beste cleanser- of which i recommend both. I decided to try something new and saw this was marketed as creamy, soothing, hydrating, agentle but strong enough to get the gunk out and fragance free. Sounded right up my alley- well this is not gentle. I have sensitive combo acne-prone leaning oily and this easily strips my skin of its natural oils- like squeaky clean. Its a great cleaner and spreads so easily that you really only need a small amount to get the job done but i restate that its a bit too harsh. If i were to rank the cleansers i used in order from least stripping and moisturizing to most stripping-  DE Beste jelly cleanser, Cerave foaming cleanser and then FAB cleanser. I could only use this is summer when i need that extra clean from all the sweat, makeup, and sunscreen that clogs my pores but thats realistically 3 months out of the year. Thats the only time my skin could handle this. And i smell the slightest- i mean slightest smell of fragrance and im sure its from the extracts they insist on putting in other than licorice- which is proven to brighten- i dont need those other potential irritants in my life. Ive never had the type of skin to use cream cleansers that usually leave a film on your skin afterwards to keep it moisturized but this is extremely drying for use during the other months of the year. With that said- my skin doesnt feel irritated from it and it hasnt broken me out after 2 weeks of consistent use. I took 1 star off for how drying it is and 1lfor that tiny hint of scent that’s possibly from the extra unnecessary extracts put in.

reviews.review_text: This oil cures all! I have hormonal breakouts and with this oil I don’t even experience them anymore. I even got my boyfriend to use this to help improve the surface of his skin and reduce his breakouts. He loved that it didn’t make his skin shine. reviews.review_title: Like my skin is drinking a green smoothie!
reviews.review_text: So, I never thought I would spend 36$ on a face wash. I love face washes that come with cotton pads because I feel they really get the dirt off of my face better than just my hands (and I’m also too lazy to use my Clairsonic because I feel like I have to clean my face and that thing). But I had to hunt for a new face wash after I realized that Aveeno stopped making their Positively Radiant cleansing pads and every store now only carries their version with salicylic acid in them. I just wanted a plain face wash with ZERO acids in it. It seems like everything has acids in it for some reason and my skin just can’t handle it. I’m sick of my facing stinging when I wash it plus I wash my face morning and night (by night I mean when I get off from work) and I just can’t keep putting acids on my face that often (I don’t mean ascorbic acid either-I’m talking AHA/BHA/SA etc). Well, I found this and I’m so glad that I did because 1. it cleansed my face so good using just my hands and didn’t sting or burn my eyes at all 2. the soap lathers really really good so a little goes a long way (which helps me feel better about the price) 3. my face didn’t immediately feel tight or dry when I smiled after washing my face instead it actually felt soft, plump and moisturized which I have never experienced after washing my face and 4. IT SMELLS SO GOOD! It smells like kale with a shot of chlorophyll but somehow delicious. It just makes me feel like my skin is drinking a green smoothie without fruit! I know it’s crazy but I feel super healthy using this face wash! I also love the glass jar because F plastic. The only downside is that I picked this up in Sephora and my box didn’t come with a pump so I just pour a little in my hand which I hope won’t translate to me pouring too much. It’s no biggie since I see so many reviews complaining about the pump. I hope it’s not difficult to pour this out of the jar once it starts getting to the bottom. Also my face oil absorbed really good with this.

reviews.review_title: Review of the REN AHA Toner
reviews.review_text: I would give this product a 4 stars.  It has a slight scent, but it is not overpowering.  As the product states, I would use this product at night.  I used this product every other night or twice a week.  When I first tried this product, my skin because red.  I was nervous because I have normal-to-dry skin and I was afraid of extreme flaking.  To my surprise, I didn’t flake at all.  I did apply a deep moisturize to combat the dryness, but there wasn’t any peeling when waking up the following morning.  After a couple uses, I did notice that my face felt smooth and soft.  I would recommend this product if you are not a fan of physical exfoliants, but I would be cautious if you have sensitive skin because using everyday is not recommended because it can cause irritations and dryness.  However, I would recommend this product to my family and friends.

reviews.product_name: Powerful-Strength Dark Circle Reducing Vitamin C Eye Serum
reviews.review_title: Review of the Kiehl's Vitamin C Eye Serum
reviews.review_text: The Kiehl’s Powerful-Strength Line-Reducing & Dark Circle-Diminishing Vitamin C Eye Serum claims to be formulated with vitamin C ingredients to help diminish the appearances of dark circle, puffiness, lines and crow’s feet.  It also formulated with Tri-Peptide and Hyaluronic Acid.  Before using this serum, I made sure to cleanse my face of any oil and dirt in the morning, then I applied this serum.  I used the serum in the morning.   After applying the serum under my eyes, I applied a moisturizer and sunscreen.  Personally, this eye serum was lightweight and layers well.  My moisturizer and sunscreen glided smoothly on top of the eye serum.  I didn’t experience any piling or buildup on my face from using all of these products on my face.  All in all, I was skeptical about this product because I wasn’t sure if this product was going to cause irritation for me.  To my surprise, I didn’t experience any irritation or redness when using this serum.   I would highly recommend this serum, Kiehl’s Powerful-Strength Line-Reducing & Dark Circle-Diminishing Vitamin C Eye Serum, to my family and friends.

reviews.review_title: Review of the Estée Lauder Night Repair Eye Cream
reviews.review_text: The Estee Lauder Advanced Night Repair Eye Supercharged Gel-Crème is that helps repair the visible signs of sleep deprivation, UV, pollution, etc.  It claims to reveal a visibly hydrated look for under the eye area.  It repairs the look of eye dryness, lines, and puffiness.  Some featured ingredients include peptides and hyaluronic acid, which is known to hydrate the skin.  Personally, I experience eye dryness under my eyes, so I was excited to put this product into use.  Upon opening, I didn’t notice a strong scent, which is perfect for people like me with sensitive under-eyes.  I quickly noticed that a little goes a long way with this product.  I applied the eye cream to my under-eye area, and I immediately could tell a difference in hydration.  My under eyes felt hydrated, and I also didn’t experience any irritations under the eyes. Since using this product, I make sure to apply it during the morning and nights.  I believe that with continued use, I will see a huge difference in my under-eye appearance.  All in all, I really enjoyed using this product, the Estee Lauder Advanced Night Repair Eye Supercharged Gel-Crème, and I would highly recommend this product to my family and friends.
